QuestInfo.name: Legendary Memories
QuestInfo.0: With the long winter coming to an end, #p9010010# has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1: The Legendary Memories event has begun!
QuestInfo.2: Let's turn these legendary times into memories that will last forever!

0.0: The holidays and Legends festivities are already coming to a close. Looking back, it was quite a crazy winter, with all the events and support from everyone. I don't think I'll ever forget Legends...and it's all thanks to you. I'm actually a little sad we have to leave it all behind...but the memories will last us a lifetime, right? I made some arrangements so we can remember these great times forever. Would you like to help me with this?

no.0: You don't want to treasure these LEGENDARY times? Whatever. Talk to me again when you change your mind.

yes.0: You have the Memory Journal I gave you, right? Well, we need to fill it with memories! Starting today, you can re-live the events of the past each day. This quest can be done every 5 minutes, so if you have special memories you wish to treasure, you better give it your best! Of course, I'll give you some super cool gifts for helping me out.

default.0: Could you check if you have empty slots in your ETC Inventory tab?
